children: DataMeds AI entered into a non-binding amended letter of intent with EOS, Scilex, Datavault, HBA, THI and REBOOT for a transaction combining intellectual property acquisitions and licenses with the acquisition of a controlling interest in HLH. The contemplated consideration includes company shares, with the named recipients and Fortitude expected to own approximately 89.5% of DataMeds AI after closing; closing depends on definitive agreements, required approvals and a liability threshold of no more than $2 million. The LOI also outlines royalties and governance changes, while REBOOT's transactions may close separately or not at all.
: Non-binding amended letter of intent for an asset acquisition, licensing and controlling-interest transaction
: EOS Technology Holdings, Scilex Holding Company, Datavault AI, HealthBridge Advisors, Tollo Health and REBOOT Health AI
: Exclusivity through Nov 30 2026; definitive agreements and closing pending
: Expand DataMeds' intellectual property, health platform and business capabilities
